detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Pinealon

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C15H26N6O8
  • Molecular Weight: 418.41 g/mol
  • Sequence: Glu-Asp-Arg (EDR)
  • Structure Class: Synthetic tripeptide (L-glutamic acid, L-aspartic acid, L-arginine)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Pinealon is a synthetic tripeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-aspartic acid, and L-arginine. It is supplied as a lyophilized powder for use exclusively in controlled in-vitro laboratory research by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:

Pinealon is used in controlled research protocols addressing topics such as:

  • Investigation of short-chain peptide signaling in cell models
  • Assay development focused on peptide stability and structure–function analysis
  • In-vitro studies exploring peptide-mediated regulatory processes
  • Comparative evaluations of tripeptide analogs in controlled systems
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic handling during laboratory use
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Pinealon is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
